name: ANGELES CREST HIGHWAY
description:
This is a great opportunity to combine your love of the outdoors with the gratification of making a significant contribution to the environment.

We will be giving this trail some much needed TLC. There are trees that need to be cleared and storm damaged tread repairs. Hike will be up to 7 miles round with 2000' gain from starting from the Buckhorn Trailhead. Shorter hike options also possible.

Pants & long-sleeved shirt, good boots/hiking shoes are required. Hard hat, gloves and safety glasses can be provided. Please be sure to bring plenty of water and your lunch.

Event will be cancelled...

name: End of Griffith Park Blvd at Shannon Rd and Cadman Dr
event_title: Perfect Weather Hike in Griffith Park! ☀️🙋🏻‍♀️ 🙋 🙋🏽‍♂️
address: 3610 Griffith Park Blvd,, Los Angeles, CA
description:
Come join the Perfect Weather Hike in Griffith Park every Saturday (location or route varies). Join us on this friendly social hike, with optional plank challenge at the helipad. Followed by optional breakfast/lunch at the Village Bakery and Cafe.

Trail Is a roughly a 4.5 mile 10,000 step loop on mostly fire roads. Distance varies depending on trail variations. We’ll have views across the city to the Pacific Ocean, Griffith Observatory, downtown LA... Moderate hike on the main fire roads with Tiffany or option for advanced inclines with Gary.

Route varies: Cadman trail to 5-Points, Beacon...

name: Placerita Canyon County Park
event_title: Placerita canyon: level 5 miles & Thai for dinner
description:
We will first explore the trail behind the nature center (15 minutes) then the hike follows a shady creekbed for a total of 5 miles. Expected weather is 79 degrees, light rain is possible

bring a guitar and/or earplugs, water, and shoes that can get wet as there are several creek crossings.

post hike dinner is at Thai Yaki. Located on Lyons ave. just east of the 5 freeway, the driveway is between a Shell and a Chevron gas station.
